explore.coast: That lake horizon looks endless, doesn’t it? Let me introduce you to the people who live and work along its shore. ♡
explore.cities: Ohio shopkeepers, muralists, and neighbors give each block its own character. A side street might turn up something charming; I’ll point out a few details I love.
explore.hills: Appalachian families carry deep ties to the places they call home. Let’s take the back road slowly and make room for the stories along the way.
explore.wild: Ohio naturalists and park volunteers keep a close eye on the creatures that share these habitats. Walk softly with me, and we might catch a glimpse. ♡
explore.past: Indigenous communities continue to carry their histories and cultural knowledge into the present. I’d be glad to explore those perspectives with you, thoughtfully.
explore.symbols: Ohioans show their local pride in all sorts of everyday ways, from county fair ribbons to game-day colors. A familiar detail can feel like home.

make.factory: Ohio machinists and assemblers bring practiced hands to every cut, fitting, and finish. I saved you a front-row spot to admire their craft.
make.flight: Ohio’s aviation teams turn measurements and test results into better designs. Ooh, there’s careful work behind that familiar shape in the sky.
make.lab: Ohio nurses, lab technicians, and patients each see a problem from a different angle. Let’s listen for the everyday questions that deserve a closer look. ♡
make.farm: Ohio growers know what a season asks of the soil. The next meal carries that work with it; I have a few questions. ♡
make.movement: Dispatchers and warehouse crews time each transfer so orders arrive together. Follow one delivery with me, and we’ll see where the waiting happens.
make.work: Ohio apprentices learn their trades beside experienced hands. Those skills pass from one generation of workers to the next, along with some good stories.

culture.records: Ohio choirs and neighborhood bands fill community halls with harmonies their audiences know by heart. Save a seat beside me and listen for the voices joining in. ♡
culture.gallery: Ohio artists use line, color, and found materials to ask all kinds of questions. Take a closer look with me and see what speaks to you.
culture.table: Restaurant owners and kitchen crews get beloved recipes ready before the rush begins. There’s so much care behind the menu; it smells delicious already.
culture.game: A home-team crowd can turn one close finish into a memory that lasts long after the lights go out. Save me a spot nearby, will you? Hehe!
culture.words: Local speakers know the rhythm of a place name better than any spelling guide. Listen for that rhythm before we give it a try. ♡
culture.invention: Ohio tool-and-die workers refine prototypes until every moving part fits. One tiny adjustment can hide an astonishing amount of cleverness.

live.campus: Ohio students carry their questions from the classroom into projects, studios, and late-night study sessions. Tell me what you’d stay up learning; maybe I’ll bring snacks. ♡
live.library: Ohio librarians help neighbors trace family histories, find local records, and track down useful answers. Bring me a question and we’ll see where it leads. ♡
live.civic: At a public hearing, residents can speak before a decision is made. Let’s listen to what neighbors care about; I’ll save you a seat near the front.
live.local: Streetlight crews, park staff, and road workers keep familiar places ready for another day. Walk with me and notice who’s already hard at work.
live.community: Neighbors keep local gatherings alive, from block parties to volunteer projects. A hello can lead to the stories people choose to share. ♡
